Sculpture199 is a declared nonrigid sculpted derivative: shared-edge refinement, bounded smoothing, narrower elongated source face, rounded existing lids and brow/nasal-ridge sculpt, continuous neck rings, oblique robe folds and chased cloth edge, smaller scalp silhouette and fine shallow carved curls. Original SC07 and source GLBs retained unchanged. No endorsement implied.
method: Bounded continuous displacement of the actual source mesh with conforming shared-edge refinement. Existing neck/ears/arms and original manifold connectivity retained. No replacement face/head, photo projection, depth cards, floating cloth or separate hair sweeps.

sourceTopologyDerivation.parentRecord: Each new vertex, in increasing ID order after original source vertices, is the arithmetic midpoint of this pair of already-existing vertex IDs. Source triangles are subdivided conformingly. UVs interpolate by the same map.

sculptDelta.format: SD19 header 20 bytes: ASCII SD19, uint32 allVertexCount, originalSourceCount, parentPairCount, version1; then little-endian float32 XYZ displacement from original vertices plus recursively constructed source-edge midpoint vertices.

compactCurls.method: Poisson selected actual scalp surface vertices; low domed relief with shallow spiral groove is sculpted into the same continuous scalp mesh, not added worms/pins.

limits: This is a hand-sculpted reconstruction derivative of a different surviving artifact, not exact photogrammetry of the reference.
No face or garment likeness is accepted by authoring metrics.
Actual front, true three-quarter, profile, body and published-view comparison must be inspected before any adoption.
No renderer/light/material/camera changes, physical export, Blend or movie.
